Overview

The Unsaid Sound is my music project: ambient textures, deep basslines and emotional soundscapes, released on YouTube and SoundCloud. Invincible Battles is the lead release. Before the studio there was the stage: I toured as the 1st Grail Knight in a Parsifal production across Ruskin Mill Trust provisions.

The problem

Some things do not fit in a report. Music is where I put them.

Approach

  • Write first, produce second.
  • Release independently and keep the rights.
  • Let the music feed the other work: the mixing desk on this site is built from it.

Tools

  • Studio production
  • YouTube
  • SoundCloud

Outcomes

  • Over 25 original tracks on SoundCloud
  • Invincible Battles released on YouTube

What I learned

Finishing a track teaches the same discipline as finishing a build: decide, ship, listen, improve.
